**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

- **Rule:** MFN (most-favoured-nation obligations burdening Customer).
- **What I checked:** § 4.1 Charges (planner's flagged section), § 14.16 Freedom of Action, the full section outline, and targeted searches for "most favored", "favorable/favourable", "no less favorable", "best price", "match", "discount", and "third party offer".
- **Result:** No pricing-parity or best-terms obligation runs against Bluefly. § 4.1 only provides that charges are specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms. § 14.16 expressly states "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others," which reinforces the absence of any exclusivity or MFN burden on us.
- **Position:** This matches our preferred position (no MFN obligation on the Customer), so I have not proposed any edit. There is also no Vendor-granted MFN in our favour to preserve — if commercial teams want best-pricing protection from IBM, that would be a separate ask rather than a defensive redline under this rule.
